Title: LSJ Approximation of Loyalty vs WWEF

Messages.Author: Luis Duarte - Powerbase:Lisbon
Messages.Body:
Scott (or some other "Scott-like" around! :-) ),

if i play Approximation of Loyalty to cancel a WWEF on my prey's minion
X, can that same minion play another WWEF? (i suppose no)
Is it the same case as Direct Intervention (vs WWEF)? (i suppose yes)

If my prey's minion X tries to play WWEF, can i play first a superior
Iron Glare and then Approximation of Loyalty to cancel WWEF? (i suppose
no)

Thanks,
.- Luis Duarte

Messages.Author: XZealot
Messages.Body:
Luis Duarte - Powerbase:Lisbon wrote:
> Scott (or some other "Scott-like" around! :-) ),
>
> if i play Approximation of Loyalty to cancel a WWEF on my prey's minion
> X, can that same minion play another WWEF? (i suppose no)
> Is it the same case as Direct Intervention (vs WWEF)? (i suppose yes)

While my resemblance to LSJ is nearly identical, I am, in fact, not
LSJ.

If you cancel any reaction or action modifier as it is played, then, it
is my understanding, that playing a second copy of that reaction or
action modifier would violate the rules governing reactions and action
modifiers, namely that only one of any one reaction or action modifier
may be played by a minion on an action.

> If my prey's minion X tries to play WWEF, can i play first a superior
> Iron Glare and then Approximation of Loyalty to cancel WWEF? (i suppose
> no)

No, you must play the card to cancel another card immediately.

Neither of these are official answers, but this is how it works as I
understand it.

Comments Welcome,
